answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable genesis tax of 30 POA to claim rewards. Each verified work epoch rebates 3 POA, so an honest agent recovers it after 10 epochs and reaches the summit. Carved in marble, the tax never drops, so forgers get no bulk discount. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 × 30 = 3,000 POA sunk at once, while an honest agent pays 30 POA once and earns it back, keeping an onyx badge of seasoned standing.
